Kit summary

Furious SmashingBasic
Deals 2 stages of 120% DEF DMG each to a single enemy, with a 40% chance to inflict [Provoke] for 1 turn.
Hammer of RampageActiveExclusive Lv.1
Deals 120% DEF DMG to all enemies, with a 70% chance to reduce their ATK by 40% for 2 turns and a 70% chance to reduce their Crit DMG by 60% for 2 turns.
Hammer of Wrath Lv.1Hammer of Rampage reduces all enemies' Turn Meter by 15%, or reduces all enemies' Turn Meter by 25% when successfully reducing their Attack.
Rage AbsorptionPassiveExclusive Lv.2
Reduces self All DMG Received by 60%. Meanwhile, each time Frich takes Direct DMG, restores self HP by 4% of Max HP and grants self 1 layer of [Overwhelming Anger], each of which increases self All DMG Received by 10%, up to 15 layers. Besides, removes 4 layers of [Overwhelming Anger] at the beginning of each turn.
Hammer of Wrath Lv.2At the beginning of each turn, removes all layers of [Overwhelming Anger], each of which increases self All DMG Received by 7% now.
Extreme RageActiveExclusive Lv.3
Inflicts [Taunt] on self for 2 turns, restores all allies' HP by 18% of Max HP, and grants them a [Shield] by 15% of Frich's Max HP for 2 turns.
Hammer of Wrath Lv.3Fury removes all debuffs from self and grants self [Block Debuff] for 2 turns before restoring HP. Besides, the value of the [Shield] granted by Fury now increases to 30% of Frich's Max HP.
